contentBody: **A transcript is too long for one single prompt. What can you do about it?**
option.1: Delete the middle section of the transcript so it fits
option.2: Paste only the start of it and ignore the rest
option.3: Summarise it section by section, then summarise the summaries
option.4: Wait until the transcript gets shorter by itself after some time
answerExplanation: Splitting long text into sections keeps the whole document in play.

contentBody: **What should belong in every single action item?**
answerExplanation: An action item names who does what by when.

contentBody: **A summary says "budget approved: ₹80,000." The transcript says ₹50,000. What kind of error is this?**
option.1: A small formatting issue in how it is laid out
option.2: A clear number mismatch with the source text
option.3: A problem with the tone of the writing
answerExplanation: Every figure must match the source exactly.
